headline: Launcher 0.8.1 brings OpenRAC to Android
summary: Launcher 0.8.1 brings the launcher and game to Android 10 and later on arm64 devices, using the player's own disc image. It adds a controller-aware touch pad, an in-game options drawer and a choice of OpenGL ES or experimental Vulkan. Historical direct development also continues on today's release-only master.
highlights: Android support lands in #15. Desktop Settings also gains experimental Vulkan, with MoltenVK bundled on macOS.
0.8.0 restores US-disc enemies, objects and movement on affected planets, including Batalia, Oltanis and Kalebo III.
Both discs gain experimental Hold and Lock strafing, fixes to widescreen seas and lava, and pause-page repairs.
A broader PAL functional-code audit finds eight differing routines and many without captured calls, so coverage remains incomplete.
#17 proposes Ratchet shadows with Windows NTSC checks only. PAL validation is still needed and the work is unmerged.
#16's Windows diagnostics and #18's Vulkan geometry repair also remain unmerged. #18 tested only limited scenes and one GPU.
